# Pricing

AcmeAI provides two subscription options: Monthly and Annual.

The Monthly plan costs $20 per user per month.

The Annual plan costs $200 per user per year.

Annual subscriptions provide a discount compared with paying
for twelve individual monthly subscriptions.

Users can change their subscription from the account settings page.

---

# Product Overview

AcmeAI is an AI-powered productivity platform designed for
individual professionals and small businesses.

The platform provides document search, AI-assisted writing,
team collaboration, and automated workflow capabilities.

Users can access AcmeAI through a web application.

The platform supports both monthly and annual subscriptions.

---

# Security

AcmeAI encrypts customer data during transmission using HTTPS.

Customer data stored by the platform is encrypted at rest.

Users can enable multi-factor authentication from their account
security settings.

AcmeAI performs regular security reviews of its infrastructure.
